content.value: The following data are collected from the books of Adcom advertising:
i) Supplies on hand at December 31, total TK 1,850 (Trail balance shows a debit balance of supplies account TK 4,000.).
ii) Automobile depreciation for the year TK 2500.
iii)Service provided but unbilled TK 4,500 at December 31.
iv)Expired insurance for the year TK 1,800.
v)Interest of TK 1,400 accrued on notes payable for the year.
vi) TK 2000 of the unearned fees has been earned.
vii) Accrued salaries at December 31 are TK 5000.
viii)Repairs of automobiles of TK 800 have been incurred but bills are unpaid.
Required: Prepare the adjusting entries for the above item.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
